topic: Peter Bala's signed Möbius–totient halting-time conjecture in OEIS A393210, Comments revision 18, 11 September 2026; alias A069517, Formula revision 31
title: A restoring and divisor-sum proof of Bala's machine-3626 conjecture of 11 September 2026, OEIS A393210, Comments, revision 18: extending Sequence Machine (2026) and Wolfram (2026)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending the pointwise formula recorded by Sequence Machine (18 April 2026) and Wolfram's (2026) worst-case analysis, we prove Peter Bala's conjecture dated 11 September 2026 in the Comments of OEIS A393210, revision 18, also stated in A069517, Formula, revision 31. For every positive integer n, the one-sided Turing machine 3626 halts after 4*2^v2(n)-3 transitions, including its final boundary crossing. A restoring block computation gives the recurrence T_(k+1)=2*T_k+3; the signed Möbius–totient divisor sum in the conjecture has the same value. The proof also gives exact timing statistics and the formulas for the two comparison machines in the same comment. A general weighted divisor identity gives the companion formulas in A069517 and A296306, including a correction to the latter entry's stated value on powers of two. The companion ordinary generating series recover Stephan's (2003) family.
summary: An all-input restoring and divisor-sum proof for machine 3626 extending Sequence Machine's recorded pointwise answer (18 April 2026) and Wolfram's worst-case analysis; comparison-machine proofs and attributed arithmetic consequences, including Stephan's 2003 generating-function family.
